sources.LGA/JFK: IEM ASOS daily.py max_temp_f (data/raw/iem/{LGA,JFK}.csv); equals the NWS CLI on 100 % of station-days from 2025-10 (docs/CONVENTIONS.md section 8), used as the CLI stand-in
sources.NYC: NWS CLI Central Park via IEM (data/raw/iem/cli/NYC_KNYC_cli.csv, column high)
sources.ladders: KXHIGHNY markets + hourly candles (data/cache/kalshi/{markets,candles}.parquet); candle ts = end_period_ts; ask/bid dollars -> cents half away from zero
sources.vintages: sha256 of the source CSV row (PAIR: sha256 of the two row hashes)

meta.synthetic: books on 2026-08-07 and 2026-08-08 are SYNTHETIC (built from the last candle ask at T = close - 24 h, 4 NO-bid levels) only to exercise the book path; the hl-mm recorder has no data yet. Every other input is real.
